original_answer:
**Cost categories and who pays**

| Category | Examples | Payer |
|---|---|---|
| **One-time** | Platform onboarding; prospectus and 485 filing work; exchange listing; ticker/CUSIP; index setup; launch marketing | Sponsor |
| **Recurring fixed** | Platform/trust minimums; administration, custody and transfer-agent minimums; audit/tax; board/CCO allocation; annual listing; data; marketing | Sponsor, paid from the unitary fee |
| **Recurring asset-based** | Platform, servicing or index-license fees charged in basis points | Sponsor, paid from the unitary fee |
| **Fund-borne exclusions** | Brokerage, taxes, interest, acquired-fund fees, extraordinary or litigation costs | Shareholders, per the advisory agreement |

**Seed assets** are invested capital, not expenditure. The sponsor recovers them at market value when redeemed. Budget only their carrying costs: market or hedging risk, financing or opportunity cost, and any capital charges.

**Break-even at a positive retained margin**

- F = annual fixed costs plus amortized one-time costs (USD)
- f = unitary fee rate
- v = variable cost rate
- m = target retained margin as a share of revenue

Required AUM = F ÷ (f(1−m) − v), valid only if f(1−m) > v. Use actual contracted quotes for each input.
